name: Ki Focus (Ki)
body:
Your focused mind allows you to sharpen your use of ki.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, ki pool class feature or Ki Meditation

Benefit(s): When you gain a numeric bonus by spending one or more points from your ki pool grants, as a free action you can increase that bonus by +1. This does not apply to constant bonuses from ki effects, such as those gained whenever you have a reserve of at least 1 point in your ki pool.

You can use ki Focus a number of times per day equal to your Wisdom bonus, with a maximum equal to your character level.

Each use of ki Focus lasts until the beginning of your next turn, and you can maintain only one ki Focus at a time.
